Printed edition: The tragedy of Cymbeline: according to the first folio (spelling modernised). With lists of ... emphasis-capitals ... also ... remarks on the consideration due to such emphasis-capitals as may be found in obscure passages , Edinburgh : Edmonston, 1879, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/tragedycymbelin00shakgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 47%, 49%, 55% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of William Shakespeare, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
